In the Vedas, the two stars, पुनर्वासू , may optionally be singular, (and connote a dual).

Terms:

In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are employed indifferently after the verbal root, as well as before it.

Terms: गति-उपसर्ग

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), शायच् is also the substitute of श्ना after the roots ending in consonants, when हि follows.

Terms: छन्दस्-शायच्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following words are found, which are formed irregularly - निष्टर्क्य , देवहूय , प्रणीय , उन्नीय , उच्छिष्य , मर्य , स्तर्या , ध्वर्य , खन्य , खान्य , देवयज्या , आपृच्छ्य , प्रतिषीव्य , ब्रह्मवाद्य , भाव्य , स्ताव्य , and पचाय्यपृड।

Terms: क्यप्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix इन् comes after the verbs वन् 'to honour', सन् 'to worship', रक्ष् 'to protect' and अथ् 'to agitate', when the object is in composition.

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix णिव comes after the verb सह् 'to bear' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after a verb with a past signification.

Terms: छन्दस्

The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' with the उपसर्ग वि when the word so formed is the name of a metre.

Terms: घञ्

Also when it is the name of a meter, the irregular form विष्टर is used.

Terms: ष change

The affix युच् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the roots having the sense of 'to go' when the word ईषद् etc. meaning 'lightly' or 'with difficulty' are in composition with such verbs.

Terms: छन्दस् युच्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the लुङ् (Aorist), लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) are optionally used in all tenses, in relation to verbs.

Terms: छन्दस्-लुङ्, लङ् and लिट्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) this distinction of सार्वधातुक and आर्द्धधातुक is not always maintained and the affixes are promiscuously used.

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the finals of तिसृ and चतसृ are found in both ways, before the Genitive 6th-Case plural नाम्।

Terms: Lengthening

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), in the case of a अङ्ग (stem) in भू or the word सुधी , are found sometimes the इवङ् and उवङ् and sometimes the semi-vowel substitution.

Terms: Semi-vowel substitution

The affixes denoting the Announcer when added to छन्दस् (Vedas) and the ब्राह्मण-sūtras express this relation only.

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the word वर्षा takes the affix ठञ् , in the remaining senses.

Terms: छन्दस्-ठञ्

The affixes यत् and अण् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon'after the word छन्दस्।

Terms: यत् and अण्

The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'this is his Law or Tradition' after the words 1. छान्दोग 2. औक्थिक 3. याज्ञिक 4. बह्वृच and 5. नट।

Terms: ञ्य

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'made' after the word छन्दस् being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: यत्

The affix यत् (य) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem), in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: यत्

For दन्त is substituted दत् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when final in a बहुव्रीहि समास ।

Terms: छन्दस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) also, the long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix घस् (इय) comes in the sense of 'season has come for it' After the verbs the word ऋतु।

Terms: घस्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the words 1. परिपन्थिन् and 2. परिपरिण् are anomalously formed by this affix and have the sense of 'an antagonist'.

Terms: छन्दस्

The आट् augment is found in the छन्दस् (Vedas) also.

Terms: अ augment

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) also, the अङ्ग (stems) 1. अस्थि 2. दधि 3. सक्थि and 4. अक्षि are found to take the substitute अन् (अनङ्) before the endings other than those mentioned above.

Terms: अनङ् augment

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the finite verb retains its accent (but not always) in connection with हि when it stands in correlation to another verb, even more than one.

Terms: Accent

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इ (or ई) or र्।

Terms: मतुप्

स् may optionally be substituted for the विसर्ग before a hard guttural or a labial in the छन्दस् (Vedas); but neither before प्र , nor before a doubled word.

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि

In the छन्दस् , न of a second term is changed into ण , when prior term ends with a short ऋ even when there is an अवग्रह or hiatus between the two terms.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-धातु
